description: Find a travel eSIM for your trip or top up a prepaid phone abroad, right from ChatGPT. Slashtel shows live data plans for 190+ destinations with price, data and validity, and lists mobile top-ups and bundles for operators in 150+ countries, such as Airtel, Jio, Telcel and MTN. When you pick a plan, Slashtel gives you a secure checkout link; you pay on slashtel.com and receive your eSIM QR code or top-up confirmation by email. No account needed.

defaultPrompt: I'm travelling to Turkey for 10 days. Find me an eSIM with enough data.
Recharge an Airtel India number with a ₹349 plan.
